annotations.title: Get a link to upload pictures

description: Makes a one-time Hollerpost page where the person can upload pictures from their own device (up to 10, JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, 5 MB each). Use it when the person has a picture you cannot pass as a public URL or base64, for example one they dropped into this chat. Give them upload_url, wait until they say they are done, then call email_images_list with the link_id to get each picture's URL. The link works once and expires after 30 minutes. Sends nothing. Requires API key scope: draft.
name: email_image_upload_link
title: Get a link to upload pictures
